basics.name: Martins Awojide
basics.label: AI Engineer · Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
basics.summary: AI Engineer and Automation Architect with a Master's in Engineering AI from Carnegie Mellon University (Distinction, GPA 3.75/4.0, Mastercard Foundation Scholar). Expert in building agentic workflows using Python, LangChain, and n8n. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with $350K+ in verified savings delivered through process optimization across manufacturing and service environments.

work.name: Carnegie Mellon University Africa
work.position: Graduate Teaching Assistant — EAI Project Methods
work.summary: Assisted students master essential elements of AI engineering like stakeholder analysis, system requirements gathering, prototyping, Agile project planning, and CI/CD by guiding hands-on assignments, clarifying core project methodologies, and supporting the final integration project.

work.name: Carnegie Mellon University Africa
work.position: Graduate Teaching Assistant — EAI System Design
work.summary: Advised 40+ graduate students on course content involving the setup and use of resource-constrained edge devices (Raspberry Pi and Arduino Nano BLE) for TinyML tasks and ModelOps (model performance analysis and maintenance) exercises using AWS, Docker, Flask and Plotly Dash.

work.name: Embedded Systems Lab, CMU-Africa
work.summary: Developed a design strategy using the IDDOV (DfX) framework for a low-cost multimodal data acquisition device, conducting Kano surveys in Africa and the USA to identify researcher needs, building a Kano model to define MVP features, and applying QFD to determine core technical specifications and guide SBC/MCU selection within a tiered product strategy.

work.name: Afretec Network, CMU-Africa
work.summary: Engaged with circa 13 Principal Investigators from 11 multi-institutional projects across partner Universities through virtual interviews to gather relevant information on the progress and goals of the projects.

work.name: Dufil Prima Foods Plc
work.summary: Handling Business Intelligence tasks and Process Improvement Strategy for the Head of Continuous Improvement & Sustainability and the C-suite at Group Corporate HQ.
highlights: Analysed financial and operational data to indicate areas of interest to process owners and the Six Sigma team at factories
Led feasibility studies and entry strategy for alternative business opportunities in the Nigerian agriculture, consumer, and financial markets
Engaged in multiple internal improvement projects assigned by Business Heads and CXOs and led the new business search thinktank
Developed inflation nowcasting models using online search volume data to inform dynamic pricing strategies

work.name: Dufil Prima Foods Plc
work.summary: Managed a department of 140+ personnel to achieve seamless warehousing operations and better integration with other departments within the Northern Noodles factory and the Corporate Logistics Team. Co-led SAP EWM implementation to replace legacy Orion ERP.
highlights: Led SAP EWM system design and deployment for inbound/outbound logistics, collaborating with SAP functional consultants on warehouse structure configuration, bin management, and RF device integration for 20+ core warehouse associates
Developed low-code data acquisition system using Google AppSheet to feed SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) module, reducing manual data entry by 65%
Introduced Kanban principles in document flow tracking between QA, Production Planning and Finance departments, improving OTDIF by 84%
Completed ISO 22000 (FSMS) and ISO 9001:2015 (QMS) audits with zero non-conformance
Reduced Warehouse/Logistics downtime from 0.85% to 0.42% YTD in 8 months
Reduced Turnaround Time for RM, PKG and FG trucks by 57% through ETA tracking and SMED implementation

work.name: Dufil Prima Foods Plc
work.summary: Black Belt Project Facilitator focused on process improvement endeavors in production settings at Raffles Oil LFTZ Ent. & Northern Noodles Plc, subsidiaries of Dufil Prima Foods Plc.
highlights: Anchored the development of a low-code software for transition to paperless reporting in three factory locations (Raffles, Insignia & Northern Noodles), reducing consumables cost by 95%
Handled a DMAIC project on laminate variance for low-volume Power Oil SKUs reducing raw material wastage from 3.28% to 1.3% in six months, resulting in $53,900 in year one and $88,800 p.a. afterwards
Managed a Lean project on packaging reliability for high-volume Power and Emperor Oil SKUs reducing product leakage from 3.2% to 1.3% in six months, with savings of $7,500 p.a.
Facilitated a project on Noodle Block Fat Content reduction for Indomie, Minimie and Mimee SKUs from 17.0% to 16.5%
Scheduled and conducted training of 40+ factory staff on 5S, Lean Six Sigma and on-the-job technicalities while mentoring newly recruited Lean Six Sigma Facilitators
